PHYSICS — MOCK EXAM #9
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: PHYSICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Electromagnetic induction? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Electromagnetic induction.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Electromagnetic induction.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Electromagnetic induction.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Electromagnetic induction.

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Dynamics? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Dynamics.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Dynamics.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Dynamics.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Dynamics.

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Transistors? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Transistors.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Transistors.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Transistors.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Transistors.

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Quantity of Heat? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Quantity of Heat.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Quantity of Heat.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Quantity of Heat.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Quantity of Heat.

5. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Milk souring
   B. Paper burning to ash
   C. Ice melting to water
   D. Iron rusting

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Introduction to Satellites Page 12 of 49 1 STRAND 1.0 MECHANICS AND THERMAL PHYS? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Introduction to Satellites Page 12 of 49 1 STRAND 1.0 MECHANICS AND THERMAL PHYS.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Introduction to Satellites Page 12 of 49 1 STRAND 1.0 MECHANICS AND THERMAL PHYS.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Introduction to Satellites Page 12 of 49 1 STRAND 1.0 MECHANICS AND THERMAL PHYS.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Introduction to Satellites Page 12 of 49 1 STRAND 1.0 MECHANICS AND THERMAL PHYS.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Floating and Sinking? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Floating and Sinking.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Floating and Sinking.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Floating and Sinking.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Floating and Sinking.

8. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Petrol fires have no fuel
   B. Water removes heat too quickly
   C. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   D. Water always increases oxygen

9. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   B. Burning crop residue every week
   C. Removing all vegetation
   D. Overgrazing continuously

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Thin lenses? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Thin lenses.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Thin lenses.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Thin lenses.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Thin lenses.

11. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. A chemical reaction forming ash
   B. Heating until a solid melts
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

12. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. watt (W)
   B. joule (J)
   C. newton (N)
   D. pascal (Pa)

13. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 37 °C
   B. 50 °C
   C. 0 °C
   D. 100 °C

14. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. Any white crystal used in cooking
   D. Any substance that conducts electricity

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Circular motion? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Circular motion.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Circular motion.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Circular motion.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Circular motion.

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Introduction to Satellites? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Introduction to Satellites.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Introduction to Satellites.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Introduction to Satellites.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Introduction to Satellites.

17. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only water vapour
   B. Only carbon dioxide
   C. Nitrogen gas only
   D. Glucose and oxygen

18. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Photoelectric effect? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Photoelectric effect.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Photoelectric effect.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Photoelectric effect.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Photoelectric effect.

19. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Decomposers only
   B. Primary consumers only
   C. Producers
   D. Tertiary consumers

20. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Mains electricity? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Mains electricity.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Mains electricity.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Mains electricity.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Mains electricity.

21. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   B. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   C. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   D. A compound can be separated by filtering only

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
22. In three clear sentences, explain Photoelectric effect and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain Electromagnetic induction and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Mains electricity and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

25. In three clear sentences, explain Transistors and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

26. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Satellites Page 12 of 49 1 STRAND 1.0 MECHANICS AND THERMAL PHYS and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

27. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Satellites and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

28. In three clear sentences, explain Dynamics and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

29. In three clear sentences, explain Circular motion and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
